svg.title: VECTORA vectorization matrix — 14 client-side raster-to-vector engines
svg.text: + 3 experimental registry primitives — SLIC superpixels · Harris corner field · Fourier epicycles
every engine emits semantic SVG — layer groups · palette · metadata — with 0 external dependencies
raster in — editable structure out. no network calls, no server round-trip, no "trace image" black box.
